summary: Forgot-password feature validated end-to-end. Backend: new POST /api/afm/auth/forgot-password proxy returns 200 with a `message` field for both registered and unknown emails (upstream intentionally generic — no user enumeration). Full pytest suite: 11/11 PASSED (9 previous + 2 new TestForgotPassword cases). Frontend (mobile viewport 390x844, FR locale): (1) forgot-password-link visible in login mode with text 'Mot de passe oublié ?'; (2) tapping link without email shows info toast 'Entrez d'abord votre e-mail'; (3) tapping link after entering customer2@afrimarket.demo shows success toast 'Si cet e-mail est enregistré, un lien de réinitialisation a été envoyé.'; (4) toggling to register mode hides the forgot-password-link (count=0) and shows name/phone fields; (5) toggling back to login re-reveals it; (6) regression — login with customer2@afrimarket.demo / Test@2026 succeeds and navigates to /(tabs) home screen with hero/categories/promotions/shops rendering live data. No new issues. Pre-existing cosmetic web-only warnings (shadow* deprecated, props.pointerEvents, useNativeDriver fallback) remain and originate from third-party RN-web/phosphor libs — non-blocking.

react_native_issues.issue: Pre-existing cosmetic warnings only (shadow* deprecated → use boxShadow; props.pointerEvents deprecated → use style.pointerEvents; Animated useNativeDriver fallback on web). Not caused by this iteration's code and not blocking.

critical_code_review_comments: login.tsx: forgot-password-link correctly rendered only when `isLogin` is true (line 153 guard) — hidden in register mode as required.
login.tsx: onForgotPassword intentionally catches errors and shows the SAME success toast — matches the security-best-practice described in the task note (no user-existence leak).
auth.tsx: forgotPassword posts to '/auth/forgot-password' which resolves to ${BACKEND}/api/afm/auth/forgot-password through the reverse proxy — correct path.
Email is trimmed+lowercased before being sent to the upstream — consistent with signIn/signUp.
Translations for forgotPassword / forgotPasswordSent / enterEmailFirst present in fr/en/es dicts — localization complete.
seed_data_creation: No new seed data. Forgot-password endpoint does not create persistent artifacts (upstream returns generic 200 regardless of email existence).
